वैदर्भी १

VAIDARBHĪ I . A wife of King sagara. This king born of the Solar dynasty, had two wives named vaidarbhī and śaibyā. vaidarbhī was also called sumati and śaibyā had another name keśinī. Of these two, vaidarbhī gave birth to sixtythousand sons and śaibyā to one son named asamañjasa. (See under sagara).

वैदर्भी २

VAIDARBHĪ II . Wife of the King kuśa. Four sons named kuśāmba, kuśanābha, Asūrtarajas and vasu were born to kuśa by vaidarbhī. (vālmīki rāmāyaṇa, Bāla Kāṇḍa, sarga 32).

वैदर्भि ३

VAIDARBHI III . A king. This King gave his daughter lopāmudrā in marriage to agastya. (M.B. Anuśāsana Parva, Chapter 137: Verse 11).

वैदेह १

VAIDEHA I . The King of videha.

वैदेह २

VAIDEHA II . See under varṇa.

वैदेह ३

VAIDEHA III . Another name of the country of videha. It has the meaning, that which is in videha. (M.B. bhīṣma parva, Chapter 9, Stanza 57).

वैद्य

VAIDYA . One of the sons born to varuṇa by his wife Sunādevī. His sons Ghṛṇi and muni fought with each other and died. (vāyu: 84: 6-8).
